user.title: Log in with your DHL account
user.description:
1. Open this link in your browser and log in with your DHL account:

{authorize_url}

2. After login the redirect will fail to load (page cannot be opened) - that's expected. Copy the full URL from the address bar (starts with `dhllogin://...`).

3. Paste the copied URL below.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew DHL login

error.invalid_code: Login failed. The code is invalid or expired - please open the link again and paste a fresh one.

abort.already_configured: This DHL account is already configured.
